description: Simulated gaussian data with an ordered partitioning variable zo declared low, mid, high, top and a nominal one zn with five levels declared v, r, t, p, s. Planted split zo <= mid, then zn in {r, p} for zo > mid. z1 is noise.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 700L
    lo <- c("low", "mid", "high", "top")
    ln <- c("v", "r", "t", "p", "s")
    d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(n), zo = factor(sample(lo, n, replace = TRUE), levels = lo, ordered = TRUE), 
        zn = factor(sample(ln, n, replace = TRUE), levels = ln), z1 = runif(n))
    low <- as.integer(d$zo) <= 2L
    rp <- d$zn %in% c("r", "p")
    b0 <- ifelse(low, 1, ifelse(rp, -1, 0.5))
    b1 <- ifelse(low, 1.5, ifelse(rp, -1, 0.5))
    d$y <- b0 + b1 * d$x + rnorm(n)
    d
}
